mapper.select: SELECT t.id,t.owner_id,t.purpose,t.status,t.title,t.current_attempt_id, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(t.manifest_json,'$.purpose')) AS manifest_purpose, JSON_EXTRACT(t.manifest_json,'$.evaluation') AS evaluation_json,t.candidate_json, a.id AS attempt_id,a.owner_id AS attempt_owner_id,a.task_id AS attempt_task_id, a.status AS attempt_status,a.finished_at, e.task_id AS binding_task_id,e.session_id,e.question_id,e.answer_id,g.answer_id AS access_answer_id FROM ai_task t LEFT JOIN ai_attempt a ON a.owner_id=t.owner_id AND a.task_id=t.id AND a.id=t.current_attempt_id LEFT JOIN ai_evaluation e ON e.owner_id=t.owner_id AND e.task_id=t.id LEFT JOIN ai_evaluation_access g ON g.owner_id=e.owner_id AND g.session_id=e.session_id AND g.question_id=e.question_id AND g.answer_id=e.answer_id WHERE t.owner_id=#{owner} AND t.id IN #{id}

SELECT s.id AS session_id,q.id AS question_id,a.id AS answer_id,s.status AS session_status,s.mode, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.config_json,'$.feedbackTiming')) AS feedback_timing, a.version_number AS answer_number,a.answer_condition,q.source_question_id,q.source_version_id, JSON_EXTRACT(t.manifest_json,'$.evaluation.question')=JSON_OBJECT( 'title',JSON_EXTRACT(q.snapshot_json,'$.content.title'), 'prompt',JSON_EXTRACT(q.snapshot_json,'$.content.prompt'), 'conditions',JSON_EXTRACT(q.snapshot_json,'$.content.conditions'), 'technology',JSON_EXTRACT(q.snapshot_json,'$.content.technology'), 'scenario',JSON_EXTRACT(q.snapshot_json,'$.content.scenario'), 'type',JSON_EXTRACT(q.snapshot_json,'$.content.type')) AS question_matches, (JSON_EXTRACT(t.manifest_json,'$.evaluation.answer.text')=JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json,'$.text') AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json,'$.diagram.nodes'))='ARRAY' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json,'$.diagram.edges'))='ARRAY' AND JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(t.manifest_json,'$.evaluation.answer.nodes'))=JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json,'$.diagram.nodes')) AND JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(t.manifest_json,'$.evaluation.answer.edges'))=JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json,'$.diagram.edges')) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM JSON_TABLE(JSON_EXTRACT(t.manifest_json,'$.evaluation.answer.nodes'), '$[*]' COLUMNS(position_index FOR ORDINALITY)) AS n WHERE NOT (JSON_EXTRACT(t.manifest_json,CONCAT('$.evaluation.answer.nodes[',n.position_index-1,']'))<=>JSON_OBJECT( 'id',JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json,CONCAT('$.diagram.nodes[',n.position_index-1,'].id')), 'label',JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json,CONCAT('$.diagram.nodes[',n.position_index-1,'].label')), 'description',JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json,CONCAT('$.diagram.nodes[',n.position_index-1,'].description'))))) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM JSON_TABLE(JSON_EXTRACT(t.manifest_json,'$.evaluation.answer.edges'), '$[*]' COLUMNS(position_index FOR ORDINALITY)) AS e2 WHERE NOT (JSON_EXTRACT(t.manifest_json,CONCAT('$.evaluation.answer.edges[',e2.position_index-1,']'))<=>JSON_OBJECT( 'id',JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json,CONCAT('$.diagram.edges[',e2.position_index-1,'].id')), 'source',JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json,CONCAT('$.diagram.edges[',e2.position_index-1,'].source')), 'target',JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json,CONCAT('$.diagram.edges[',e2.position_index-1,'].target')), 'label',JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json,CONCAT('$.diagram.edges[',e2.position_index-1,'].label')))))) AS answer_matches, v.id AS standard_version_id, CASE WHEN q.source_question_id IS NULL THEN JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(t.manifest_json,'$.evaluation.standard'))='NULL' ELSE JSON_EXTRACT(t.manifest_json,'$.evaluation.standard')=JSON_OBJECT( 'questionId',q.source_question_id,'versionId',q.source_version_id,'status',v.standard_status, 'referenceAnswer',v.reference_answer,'checkpoints',CAST(v.checkpoints_json AS JSON)) END AS standard_matches FROM ai_task t LEFT JOIN ai_evaluation e ON e.owner_id=t.owner_id AND e.task_id=t.id LEFT JOIN training_session s ON s.owner_id=e.owner_id AND s.id=e.session_id LEFT JOIN training_question q ON q.owner_id=e.owner_id AND q.session_id=e.session_id AND q.id=e.question_id LEFT JOIN training_answer a ON a.owner_id=e.owner_id AND a.session_id=e.session_id AND a.question_id=e.question_id AND a.id=e.answer_id LEFT JOIN question_version v ON v.owner_id=q.owner_id AND v.question_id=q.source_question_id AND v.id=q.source_version_id WHERE t.owner_id=#{owner} AND t.id=#{taskId}

SELECT d.id,d.owner_id,d.task_id,d.feedback_id,d.revision,d.choice,d.created_at FROM ai_feedback_decision d WHERE d.owner_id=#{owner} AND d.task_id=#{taskId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_feedback_decision n WHERE n.owner_id=d.owner_id AND n.task_id=d.task_id AND n.feedback_id=d.feedback_id AND n.revision>d.revision) ORDER BY d.feedback_id ASC LIMIT 13
